description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions — Drop-in OpenAI-style chat endpoint: POST the standard chat.completions JSON body (messages with system, user and assistant roles, max_tokens, temperature, top_p) and get a chat.completion object back. Llama 3.3 70B. Pay per call in USDC on Base with x402 instead of an API key; point an OpenAI-compatible client at this base URL. Streaming is not supported. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

messages.description: array of {role, content} chat messages (OpenAI format)
